# Copilot Instructions for BiYeSheji

## Project Overview
This is a graduation project (毕业设计) repository for Feng Yiran (封怡然).

## General Guidelines

### Code Style
- Follow consistent coding standards appropriate for the project's programming language
- Use clear and descriptive variable and function names
- Add comments for complex logic, preferably in Chinese when appropriate for this project

### Project Structure
- Maintain organized file structure as the project grows
- Keep related files grouped together logically

### Documentation
- Document key features and functionality
- Provide clear README files for major components
- Include setup and usage instructions where applicable

### Best Practices
- Write clean, maintainable code
- Consider code reusability
- Follow DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principle
- Implement proper error handling

### Testing
- Write tests for critical functionality when applicable
- Ensure code changes don't break existing features

### Commit Messages
- Write clear, descriptive commit messages
- Use Chinese or English as appropriate for the project context

## Language Preferences
This project may include Chinese documentation and comments where appropriate, as it is a graduation project for a Chinese-speaking student.
